title: CHITIN ON ICE // ASSAULT OF THE FROST SPIDERS
narrative: The cold that heralded their coming dropped the temperature forty degrees in five heartbeats. Scaling the seven-hundred-foot frozen vertical facade of the Wall came hundreds of pale, translucent frost spiders as large as destriers, their eight needle-like legs biting effortlessly into the ice. Watchmen on the catwalks panicked as blue-eyed wights swarmed up behind the arachnids. Jon Snow drew Longclaw, shouting orders to tip the barrels of burning pitch. A river of boiling resin cascaded down the ice face, turning fifty spiders into hissing torches of blue flame, but thousands more crawled through the blizzard from the Haunted Forest.
resolvesPlotHole: The Legendary Ice Spiders Big as Hounds
